{"metadata":{"description":"dsh-better-sidebar 侧边栏 Tab 版文件改动审查：行级红绿 diff + 撤销，chat 行深链（移植自 left0ver/dsh-file-review）/ Review agent file changes as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab — line-level diffs + undo, ported from left0ver/dsh-file-review","id":"gh:1339042910","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-file-review-tab","slug":"Lzh3070/dsh-file-review-tab","topics":["dsh-better-sidebar","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"dsh-better-sidebar 侧边栏 Tab 版文件改动审查：行级红绿 diff + 撤销，chat 行深链（移植自 left0ver/dsh-file-review）/ Review age"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"nt file changes as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab — line-level diffs + undo, ported from left0ver/"},{"id":"p1s3","text":" as a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab — line-level diffs + undo, ported from left0ver/dsh-file-review"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-file-review-tab"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"把 dsh-file-review（作者 left0ver）的"改动审查"能力移植为 dsh-better-sidebar 的侧边栏 Tab，并保留对话尾部的审查行——两个入口同源，互不干扰。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> Port of left0ver/dsh-file-review's change-review capability into a dsh-better-sidebar sidebar tab,"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" keeping the chat turn-tail review row."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 功能"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **对话尾部审查行**：回合结束出现"已编辑 N 个文件 +M −K / 撤销 / 审查"；点「审查」或单个文件名，**深链打开侧边栏 Tab，自动展开对应文件的 diff 并定位到该轮分组顶部*"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"*（不再弹全宽 drawer）。
- **侧边栏 Tab「文件审查」**：按轮次分组列出本会话改动文件；点击展开行级红绿 diff；支持撤销本轮 / 单文件撤销 / 重新应用；Tab 角标实时显示改动"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"文件数。
- **删除文件可见**：dsh 没有删除文件的工具，删除发生在终端命令里——插件解析 `rm` 族命令（`rm` / `rmdir` / `unlink` / `Remove-Item` "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"/ `del` / `rd` 等）的字面路径参数，被删文件以「已删除」标记出现在两个入口（内容已不存在，故无行级 diff、不可撤销）。带通配符（`rm *.log`）或命令替换（`rm $(...)"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"`）的删除不识别——受影响文件事后无法枚举。
- **自动归档**：主列表只保留最近 5 轮（进行中的轮次永不归档），更早的已完成轮次沉入底部「已归档 N 轮」折叠区。折叠时归档内容零渲染，展开后每页"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"加载 10 轮（「加载更多」续页），diff 行另有懒挂载——长会话不再一次性挂载几十个 diff 组。深链跳到已归档轮次会自动展开并定位；展开状态按会话记忆；角标只统计主列表。
- **PTC / "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"Code Mode 支持**：`run_code` 程序内部的 `edit`/`write` 子调用也会被捕获——Host 端快照完整 before/after，浏览器端重建带行号的行级 hunks "},{"id":"p6s8","text":"并入所属轮次；diff 查看、状态检查、撤销/重做均可用。标准模式行为不变（对话尾部审查行仍只覆盖标准模式轮次）。
- **会话隔离**：每个会话只看自己的改动；Tab 不可见时暂停状态巡检。
- *"},{"id":"p6s9","text":"*窄容器自适应**：工作台横向分屏半宽或浮动独立窗口下，轮次头部自动换行、次要信息（行数统计、「在编辑器中打开」）让位，撤销操作与文件名始终完整。
- **样式隔离**：全部 CSS Module +"},{"id":"p6s10","text":" 宿主 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌，不与对话区或其他插件冲突。"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 安装"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"前置依赖：DeepSeek Harness web（**0.1.5-rc.1+**，已在 0.1.5-rc.1 / 0.1.5-rc.2 上真机验证）+ dsh-better-sidebar（≥ 0."},{"id":"p9s2","text":"eepSeek Harness web（**0.1.5-rc.1+**，已在 0.1.5-rc.1 / 0.1.5-rc.2 上真机验证）+ dsh-better-sidebar（≥ 0.19.1）。"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> **版本对应**：`dsh-file-review-tab@0.5.x` 只支持 DSH 0.1.5 及更新的侧边栏 API；仍停留在 DSH 0.1.2 / 0.1.1 的用户请继续使用 `ds"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"h-file-review-tab@0.4.1`。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"安装后**重启 dsh web**，在 better-sidebar 侧边栏「+」菜单打开「文件审查」即可。"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"MIT"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Features (English)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- Chat turn-tail review row ("Edited N files +M −K · Undo · Review") that deep-links into the sideba"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"r tab (auto-expanding the diffs and scrolling the turn group to the top) instead of a full-width dra"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"wer.
- Sidebar tab "File Review" in dsh-better-sidebar: per-turn grouped changed files, line-level r"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ed/green diffs, undo per turn or per file, live badge with the changed-file count.
- Deleted files s"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"tay visible: dsh has no delete-file tool, so deletions happen in terminal commands — literal `rm`-fa"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"mily arguments (`rm`, `rmdir`, `unlink`, `Remove-Item`, `del`, …) are parsed and deleted files appea"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"r marked "deleted" in both surfaces (no line diff, no undo: the content is gone). Glob/command-subst"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"itution deletions are not guessed.
- Auto-archive: only the newest 5 turns stay in the main list (li"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"ve turns never archive); older completed turns sink into an "Archived turns" section pinned to the t"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"ab's bottom. Collapsed it renders nothing; open, it loads 10 turns per page. Deep links auto-open an"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"d page to their target; the badge counts the main list only.
- Session-isolated, pause-when-hidden, "},{"id":"p15s12","text":"CSS-Module scoped styling (no conflicts with the chat area or other plugins).
- Narrow-pane adaptive"},{"id":"p15s13","text":": in half-width splits and floated free windows the turn header wraps and secondary content yields s"},{"id":"p15s14","text":"o undo and file names never clip."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Requires DeepSeek Harness web (0.1.5-rc.1+, verified on 0.1.5-rc.1 / 0.1.5-rc.2) and dsh-better-side"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"bar (≥ 0.19.1). `dsh-file-review-tab@0.5.x` targets only the DSH 0.1.5 client API; users on DSH 0.1."},{"id":"p16s3","text":"2 / 0.1.1 should stay on 0.4.1. Restart `dsh web` after installing, then open the "File Review" tab "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"from the sidebar's "+" menu."}],"truncated":false}
